name: Scrimshank's Surveying Gear
summary: Scrimshank's Surveying Gear lies beneath the sands of Tanaris, in the Gaping Chasm. Its findings matter to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser's search for a missing assistant and the strange bugs in the desert.

sections.title: Beneath the Sands
sections.body: In the Gaping Chasm of Tanaris, Scrimshank's Surveying Gear is all that may be found of the missing Junior Surveyor. His senior, Fizzledowser, sent him into the desert after reports of strange bugs. The machine carries Scrimshank's last records, which may help explain the danger facing Gadgetzan.

faq.answer: It is the surveying equipment of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, found beneath Tanaris in the Gaping Chasm.
Scrimshank's Surveying Gear lies in the Gaping Chasm beneath Tanaris.
Junior Surveyor Scrimshank was Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser's assistant, sent to investigate strange bugs in the Gaping Chasm.

faq.q: Why does Fizzledowser want the gear?
faq.answer: Fizzledowser hopes Scrimshank's records will help reveal what is happening with the strange bugs in the desert.
